Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study focuses on proteoform-resolved kinetics of Plasminogen (Plg) activation to Plasmin (Plm). The primary biological variables are the PTM states (glycosylation and phosphorylation) and the activation state induced by enzymatic activators (uPa, tPa, SAK). While activators are enzymes, they act as the perturbing agents in this kinetic MS study.
